incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated tool execution errors and increased p95 on hosted-generation pool (hosted-gen-3). metric: tool_exec_errors=37% over 3m, gpu_mem_pressure rising. paging eng-oncall

zoe.oncall: acknowledged, joining. pulling logs and recent deploy diffs.

marta.prod: seeing spike correlated with structured JSON responses from the assistant->tool flow. customer telemetry shows big batched arrays from analytics tenants.

lee.eng: I can throttle at the edge. propose temporary policy: reject tool_exec requests for plan=free and plan=bursting with 429s and add low-fidelity fallback generation. Also flip structured_output off for same scopes.

carlos.support: we've already received 3 chats about timeouts. I'll prepare a short message for affected customers and DM the top noisy tenants.

ember.ops: GPU OOMs on 3 hosts at 02:14 UTC, recall a recent cache eviction change in PR 4672 touched kv eviction thresholds.

zoe.oncall: mitigation plan: 1) Canary feature toggle to disable external-agent/tool execution for hosted free/burst tenants 2) Disable structured_output for same scopes 3) Apply tenant-scoped rate limits to top noisy clients and reduce default per-request tool timeout to 2s

lee.eng: commands i will run (canary 1 host -> 5 -> global):

```
edgectl feature set --flag allow_agent_exec=false --env hosted --plans free,burst --canary 1
edgectl feature set --flag structured_output=false --env hosted --plans free,burst --canary 1
edgectl rate set --tenant Tenant_MediaLab --limit 20r/s --scope agent_exec
```

zoe.oncall: initiating canary on host hosted-gen-3a now.

incident-bot: CHANGE: allow_agent_exec=false (canary) change_id=chg_1719991234_1

ember.ops: canary host CPU down ~25% in 90s, tool_exec_errors on canary host fell to 6%. no regressions on non-canary traffic so far.

marta.prod: drafted status update: "Temporary change: agent-based tools and structured JSON outputs restricted on free/burst plans to stabilize service. No action needed for paid Dedicated/Private customers." will publish after roll decision.

lee.eng: rolling to 5 canaries. applying tenant throttles for noisy list: Tenant_MediaLab, Tenant_QuickShop, Tenant_OpenBeta, Tenant_TrialTeam, Tenant_AnalyticsX.

incident-bot: CHANGE: structured_output=false (canary) change_id=chg_1719991234_2

carlos.support: notified affected tenants via DM and added WIP note to support tickets.

ember.ops: monitoring cluster: p95 latency down 35% across hosted-gen pool, gpu mem pressure stabilizing, OOMs stopped on patched hosts.

zoe.oncall: rolling to global scope for plans free,burst in 3m if metrics hold. maintain dedicated/private unaffected.

lee.eng: router patch: prefer cached responses and short-circuit agent path when structured_output requested under limited plans. fallback to best-effort plain-text generation.

marta.prod: published status page entry and attached list of impacted tenant handles.

incident-bot: NOTE: tenant-level quota adjustments applied to Tenant_AnalyticsX and Tenant_QuickShop; enterprise customers unaffected.

carlos.support: customers appreciate the proactive note. a couple asked for ETA. i told them 30-60m and that we're monitoring.

zoe.oncall: follow-ups and owner handoff: - lee.eng to own router rule revert and incremental ramp plan - ember.ops to file post-incident change for PR 4672 KV-cache adjustments - marta.prod to maintain customer comms - alex.oncall to watch overnight and escalate if errors >10% again

alex.oncall: taking handoff, will keep mitigations in place and monitor for 45m. ping me if we want an earlier rollback.

zoe.oncall: set incident severity P1->P2 after 30m of stability. tagging postmortem owner: ember.ops.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: agent/tool execution curtailed for hosted free/burst plans; structured_output disabled for same scopes; tenant throttles applied to top noisy tenants. monitoring ongoing. thread_ts=1719991234
